rows.grounds: locative of compound tad-mūla, referring to the base of the previously described component
compound kalaśa-ākāra describing the form as resembling a pot
compound dvi-aṅgula indicating a measure of two aṅgulas; surface preserves the transmitted orthography
bahuvrihi daśa-nāha-ka indicating a circumference of ten nāha units, continuing the dimensional description

items.question: What shape and measurements are specified for the base of the described component?
premises: The base of the described component is being characterized.
Its form is specified as pot-shaped.
Its extent is two aṅgulas and its circumference is ten nāha units.
items.inference: Therefore the base of the component is defined as a pot-shaped section with specified dimensions.
uncertainties: The exact unit value of nāha in this context is inferred from the preceding verse's use of nāha for circumference.
items.plain_english: At its base, it is pot-shaped, measuring two aṅgulas and having a circumference of ten nāha units.
